integrity: The all-n result is proved analytically from the conditional interior-uniform law and exact beta moments. Exact finite rational checks through n=250 are supplementary and do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to iid sampling from a continuous uniform interval and the usual unbiased sample variance.
The variance comparison is only against the ordinary unbiased sample variance; no UMVU or global admissibility claim is made.
A broad 1959 location-scale unbiased-estimation source could not be fully text-inspected because the authorized scan was not machine-readable.
title: Exact range projection of sample variance under a uniform law
